Planning a marbella boat rental stag weekend cost 2040? You've come to the right place. With prices starting at €749 for a 2-hour charter on a 12.5m Astondoa 40 (9 guests) or Azimut 39 (11 guests), a day on the Costa del Sol is surprisingly affordable. All our boats depart from Puerto Banús, Marbella, and include a licensed skipper, fuel, drinks, snacks, and insurance – no hidden fees. Below, we break down every cost, boat option, and inclusion so you can budget your bachelor party with confidence.

Why Choose a Boat Rental for Your Stag Weekend?

A private boat charter is the ultimate way to celebrate a stag weekend in Marbella. You get exclusive use of the yacht, a dedicated skipper, and the freedom to explore the Mediterranean at your own pace. Swim at secluded coves like Cala del Faro or Cala Cortés, cruise past the Golden Mile, and enjoy unlimited drinks and snacks without queuing at a bar. With the backdrop of La Concha mountain and the Puerto Banús skyline, it's an experience your group will never forget.

What's Included – No Surprises

Every charter comes with a professional licensed skipper who knows the best spots along the coast. Fuel is fully covered, so you can cruise from Puerto Banús to Estepona or Sotogrande without worrying about costs. The drinks package includes water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, and cava – perfect for toasting the groom. Light snacks are provided, and you're welcome to bring your own food (no glass, please). Insurance and all safety equipment are included, as is the 21% Spanish VAT.

For groups of 8–11, the Astondoa 40 or Azimut 39 are excellent value at €749 for 2 hours. If you want more space and a free jet ski, the Mangusta 80 (24m, 12 guests) at €4,719 for 4 hours is a showstopper. For larger parties or those wanting a superyacht experience, ask about the Ferretti 94 (29m) or Canados 86 (26m) – pricing on request via WhatsApp. All boats depart from Puerto Banús, so you're minutes from Marbella's best nightlife.

How to Book Your Stag Boat Party

Booking is simple. Browse our fleet, choose your preferred yacht, and contact us via WhatsApp for availability and pricing on specific dates. We recommend reserving at least 3–6 months ahead for summer weekends (June–September). A deposit secures your booking, and we'll confirm everything in writing. For more inspiration, check out our Marbella boat rental guide.

  • Start early: depart at 10:00 to make the most of calm seas and sunny weather.
  • Bring a Bluetooth speaker for your playlist – most boats have aux inputs.
  • Pack plenty of sunscreen and a hat – the Mediterranean sun is strong even in spring.
  • Plan a swim stop at Cala del Faro or Cala Cortés – crystal-clear water and fewer crowds.
  • Arrange a post-boat dinner at a chiringuito on the beach – ask your skipper for recommendations.
